controls.title: Ensure Microsoft 365 audit log search is Enabled
controls.description: Unified audit log search must be turned on for the tenant.
controls.rationale: Without the unified audit log there is no forensic record of administrative or user activity, and no incident can be reconstructed.
controls.nistCategory: DE.AE-03 Information is correlated from multiple sources

audit.name: Read the unified audit log ingestion flag

assertions.failure: Unified audit log ingestion is {actual}; tenant activity is not being recorded for investigation.

rollback.name: Restore the previous audit log ingestion setting

controls.title: Ensure DLP policies are enabled
controls.description: At least one data loss prevention policy must be enabled across Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive.
controls.rationale: DLP is the control that stops regulated data leaving the tenant through everyday collaboration.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users may be blocked or warned when sharing content that matches a sensitive information type.
controls.auditProcedure: Get-DlpCompliancePolicy | Select-Object Name, Mode, Enabled, Workload
controls.remediationProcedure: Create a DLP policy in Microsoft Purview covering Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams, then set its mode to Enable.

assertions.failure: No data loss prevention policy is enabled in this tenant ({actual}).
assertions.hint: Create and enable a Purview DLP policy scoped to Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.

controls.title: Ensure DLP policies are enabled for Microsoft Teams
controls.description: A DLP policy must include the Teams workload.
controls.rationale: Teams chat and channel messages are a common exfiltration path that Exchange-only DLP misses.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Messages containing sensitive information types may be blocked.
controls.remediationProcedure: Edit an existing DLP policy in Microsoft Purview and add the Teams chat and channel messages location.

assertions.failure: No DLP policy covers the Teams workload ({actual}).
assertions.hint: Add the Teams chat and channel messages location to an existing DLP policy.

controls.title: Ensure SharePoint Online Information Protection policies are set up and used
controls.description: Sensitivity labels must be published and applied to SharePoint content.
controls.rationale: Labels drive encryption and access restrictions that survive the file leaving the tenant.
controls.remediationProcedure: Create and publish sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview, then enable them for files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

assertions.failure: No sensitivity labels are published ({actual}), so content in SharePoint cannot be classified or protected.
assertions.hint: Publish at least a Confidential and a Highly Confidential label and enable them for files.
